name: Subhashish Banerjee
title: Peaceful family holiday just 2 mins from sea beach
comment: Hotel Dollhouse in Barrister Colony is a hidden gem. Far away from the noisy New Digha commercial rush, yet the sea beach is literally a 2-minute stroll. The carved teak wood bed and ambient ceiling lighting were stunning. Clean western bathroom and prompt service. Highly recommended for families!

name: Priyanka & Anirban Das
title: Mesmerizing dome ceiling and very courteous owner
comment: We booked the Royal Emerald Dome Room directly via WhatsApp with Mr. D.K. Ghosh. The glowing dome false ceiling looks magical at night. Spotless linens, quiet split AC, and safe gated car parking. Best rate without any third-party app commission.

name: Debabrata Sengupta
title: Spotless rooms and genuinely warm hospitality
comment: Stayed for 3 nights with my elderly parents. They loved the quiet residential neighborhood of Barrister Colony. Running hot and cold water 24/7, very comfortable mattress, and the staff helped us with fresh tea and food arrangements promptly.

name: Amitava Roy
title: Fresh sea breeze from the private balcony
comment: The private balcony in the Executive Suite was perfect for evening chats with the sea breeze blowing in. Fast direct WhatsApp check-in and hassle-free UPI payment on arrival. We will definitely visit again!
